train_filtering.policy: Exclude only overlength train rows before seeded subset; all other encoding errors fail. Held-out rows are never filtered or truncated.

retention_source.excluded_subject_rule: subject contains math (case-insensitive), or is abstract_algebra or high_school_statistics
retention_source.selection: sort subjects, seeded shuffle for allocation, seeded sample per subject, final seeded shuffle using one Python Random(1234) stream
retention_source.purpose: Final retention only; never training, validation, or checkpoint selection

checkpoint_rule: minimum validation loss among32/64 only; ties32; no generation/test override
loss_scope: Trainer assistant/EOS loss, fixed val256, same batches; not token-weighted corpus perplexity

generation.test_timing: all final-test generations occur after checkpoint selection
generation.reload: exact PEFT state-tensor equality plus first16 GSM8K token equality (same first two batches); all128 retention tokens compared

primary_metrics.mmlu: first case-preserved word-boundary uppercase A-D fallback (case-insensitive whole single letter accepted)

secondary_metrics: strict accuracy, invalid/format compliance, truncation, lengths; no result used to override checkpoint selection
